general.configureHowLongAutomatic: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
general.controlWhetherThumbsUp: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.

general.paragraphIntro: Thread interactions are open by default:
general.paragraphAfterAnyone: in the organization — the board or any agent, including the one that asked — can respond. Narrow a kind only when you need to.
general.paragraphAfterDefaultPolicy: is the audience new cards get when the requester does not ask for one;
general.paragraphAfterCap: narrows every request of that kind and can never widen one. Tool-approval confirmations always stay
general.unsetEffectDefaultPolicy: New cards are open — the board or any agent can respond, including the one that asked.
general.unsetEffectCap: A request keeps whatever audience it asks for.
general.defaultPolicyEffectNotCreator: New cards exclude the agent that created them, so the answer comes from someone else.
general.defaultPolicyEffectHumanOnly: New cards wait for a person on the board. Agents are turned away.
general.capEffectNotCreator: Even a card that asks for Anyone is narrowed to exclude its creator.
general.capEffectHumanOnly: Every card of this kind waits for a person, whatever it asked for.

general.name: Display name for this agent.
general.jobTitleShownIn: Job title shown in the org chart.
general.role: Organizational role. Determines position and capabilities.
general.reportsTo: The agent this one reports to in the org hierarchy.
general.capabilities: Describes what this agent can do. Shown in the org chart and used for task routing.
general.adapterType: How this agent runs: local CLI (Claude/Codex/OpenCode), OpenClaw Gateway, spawned process, or generic HTTP webhook.
general.cwd: Deprecated legacy working directory fallback for local adapters. Existing agents may still carry this value, but new configurations should use project workspaces instead.
general.promptTemplate: Sent on every heartbeat. Keep this small and dynamic. Use it for current-task framing, not large static instructions. Supports {{ agent.id }}, {{ agent.name }}, {{ agent.role }} and other template variables.
general.model: Override the default model used by the adapter.
general.thinkingEffort: Control model reasoning depth. Supported values vary by adapter/model.
general.chrome: Enable Claude's Chrome integration by passing --chrome.
general.dangerouslySkipPermissions: Run unattended by auto-approving adapter permission prompts when supported.
general.dangerouslyBypassSandbox: Run Codex without sandbox restrictions. Required for filesystem/network access.
general.search: Enable Codex web search capability during runs.
general.fastMode: Enable Codex Fast mode. This burns credits/tokens much faster and is supported on GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and manual Codex model IDs.
general.workspaceStrategy: How Paperclip should realize an execution workspace for this agent. Keep project_primary for normal cwd execution, or use git_worktree for issue-scoped isolated checkouts.
general.workspaceBaseRef: Base git ref used when creating a worktree branch. Leave blank to use the resolved workspace ref or HEAD.
general.workspaceBranchTemplate: Template for naming derived branches. Supports {{issue.identifier}}, {{issue.title}}, {{agent.name}}, {{project.id}}, {{workspace.repoRef}}, and {{slug}}.
general.worktreeParentDir: Directory where derived worktrees should be created. Absolute, ~-prefixed, and repo-relative paths are supported.
general.runtimeServicesJson: Optional workspace runtime service definitions. Use this for shared app servers, workers, or other long-lived companion processes attached to the workspace.
general.maxTurnsPerRun: Maximum number of agentic turns (tool calls) per heartbeat run.
general.command: The command to execute (e.g. node, python).
general.localCommand: Override the path to the CLI command you want the adapter to call (e.g. /usr/local/bin/claude, codex, opencode).
general.extraArgs: Extra CLI arguments for local adapters, comma-separated.
general.envVars: Environment variables injected into the adapter process. Use plain values or secret references.
general.secretAccess: Secrets this agent can reach. Env-var bindings are injected at run start; API-access bindings are fetched on demand via the run-bound agent API and never written to the environment.
general.bootstrapPrompt: Only sent when Paperclip starts a fresh session. Use this for stable setup guidance that should not be repeated on every heartbeat.
general.payloadTemplateJson: Optional JSON merged into remote adapter request payloads before Paperclip adds its standard wake and workspace fields.
general.webhookUrl: The URL that receives POST requests when the agent is invoked.
general.heartbeatInterval: Run this agent automatically on a timer. Useful for periodic tasks like checking for new work.
general.timeoutSec: Maximum seconds a run can take before being terminated. 0 means no timeout.
general.graceSec: Seconds to wait after sending interrupt before force-killing the process.
general.wakeOnDemand: Allow this agent to be woken by assignments, API calls, UI actions, or automated systems.
general.cooldownSec: Minimum seconds between consecutive heartbeat runs.
general.maxConcurrentRuns: Maximum number of heartbeat runs that can execute simultaneously for this agent.
general.maxTurnContinuationEnabled: Automatically queue bounded continuation runs when an adapter stops because its per-run turn cap was exhausted.
general.maxTurnContinuationMaxAttempts: Maximum automatic continuations after one max-turn stop. This is separate from max turns per run.
general.maxTurnContinuationDelaySec: Seconds to wait before starting each max-turn continuation.
general.budgetMonthlyCents: Monthly spending limit in cents. 0 means no limit.

general.effectAnyone: Anyone in the organization can respond — the board or any agent, including the one that asked.
general.effectNotCreator: Anyone in the organization except the agent that created the card, and its run. Use this when the answer has to come from someone else.
general.effectHumanOnly: Only a person on the board can respond. Agents are turned away.
general.humanOnlyCannotResolve: Only a person on the board can respond — agents cannot resolve this card.
general.onlyAddresseeOrBoardCanRespond: Only {{addressee}} or a person on the board can respond.
general.anyoneExceptCreatorCanRespond: Anyone in the organization except {{creator}} can respond.
general.onlyAddresseeOrBoardCanRespondShort: Only {{addressee}} or the board can respond
general.governedActionNote: This card runs a governed action, so it stays human-only whatever audience was requested.
general.companyCapNarrowed: Organization interaction governance narrowed this from {{from}} to {{to}}.
general.legacyRestrictionNote: Created before Anyone became the default, so it stays restricted. A new card would be open.

general.howToGetA: How to get a full path
general.macStepOpenFinder: Open Finder and navigate to the folder.
general.macStepHoldOption: Hold the Option (⌥) key — "Copy" changes to "Copy as Pathname".
general.macStepClickCopy: Click "Copy as Pathname", then paste here.
general.macTip: You can also open Terminal, type cd, drag the folder into the terminal window, and press Enter. Then type pwd to see the full path.
general.windowsStepOpenExplorer: Open File Explorer and navigate to the folder.
general.windowsStepClickAddressBar: Click in the address bar at the top — the full path will appear.
general.windowsStepCopyPath: Copy the path, then paste here.
general.windowsTip: Alternatively, hold Shift and right-click the folder, then select "Copy as path".
general.linuxStepOpenTerminal: Open a terminal and navigate to the directory with cd.
general.linuxStepRunPwd: Run pwd to print the full path.
general.linuxStepCopyOutput: Copy the output and paste here.
general.linuxTip: In most file managers, Ctrl+L reveals the full path in the address bar.
